name: CAIRN
author: cvhviz
description: Cairn is a fork of the MeshCore companion firmware. Every board is built from one source tree that shares MeshCore mesh and radio code, and every build works with the official MeshCore apps (web, Android, iOS).

name: Faro
author: radek-sixi
description: Faro is a touch, keyboard and trackball UI (LVGL 9.3) for the MeshCore companion firmware. It runs on the device next to the normal companion interfaces, so the MeshCore phone app (BLE) and TCP clients (Wi-Fi, port 5000) keep working while you use the screen.

name: Launcher
author: bmorcelli
description: With this app you can turn your device into a swiss knife, loading any .bin you have on your SD Card or wirelessly downloading from M5Burner repo or from your computer/smartphone through its WebUI.

name: MeshOS (Elecrow ThinkNode M9)
author: meshcore
description: Easy to use, smartphone-like MeshCore experience. Activate your license on: https://meshcore.co.uk/activate.html

author: Meshtastic
description: An open source, off-grid, decentralized mesh network built to run on affordable, low-power devices. No cell towers. No internet. Just pure peer-to-peer connectivity.
name: Meshtastic

description: Standalone Reticulum for T-Deck, T-LoraPager and ThinkNode M9, based on microReticulum.
